ImageDescription.value: After the street market in the lane adjoining the Macau tourist office is the Sam Kai Vui Kun temple or Kuan Tai temple. A brochure I picked up at the tourist office says that this temple stands at the site of the old Macau bazaar, whose sign still exists. (the one right on top). Prior to the establishment of the local chamber of commerce in 1912, the precincts of the temple were the centre of Chinese trade in Macau. Jan/ Feb. 2012.
